Clouds-D-mini — visible volumetric clouds (standalone)

Sets up pmndrs EffectComposer + RenderPass + EffectPass(CloudsEffect) with procedural cloud textures (LocalWeather + CloudShape + CloudShapeDetail + Turbulence). Renders N frames against a synthetic noon DayGroup. PASS if the canvas has non-uniform pixels (proves the cloud composite landed on the buffer) AND there are no shader-link or texture-bake errors in the console.
